fields.name: tpe
fields.comment: Basic type of the switch, e.g. SS → Simple Switch, DS → Double Switch, DCS → Double Crossing Switch

fields.name: sub_tpe
fields.comment: Summary of curve as L/R of the different edges, sorted by radius: LL, L, R, RR

schema.name: edges

fields.name: node_side
fields.comment:
side of the node this edge got assigned to.  
Note: the graph traversal rule is that at a node the side needs to be switched, e.g. the next edge must start on the other side of the node.

fields.name: position_from
fields.comment: start position of the switch on this edge (this is always the smaller position value)

fields.name: position_to
fields.comment: end position of the switch on this edge (this is always the larger position value)

fields.name: main_edge
fields.comment: true if this is the main edge of the switch, if false it is a turnout edge.

schema.comment: mapping of the switch on the edges
